title: SvgPath
responsibility: Renders the native path element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgPath.attributes
inputs.description: Native path attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgPath.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native path element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgPath
outputs.description: The actual native path element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
